whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Gokul Cake Shop,

I noticed your bakery has strong 4.4★ reviews in Kankarbagh, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for online cake orders and custom celebration inquiries.

Maine aapke cake shop ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake ordering, birthday/anniversary menu, aur custom cake gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gokul

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Gokul Cake Shop team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and custom cake showcase for Kankarbagh customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake varieties, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
